{{Top}}
{{Otheruses|Belt}}
{{MoreSources}}
'''Belts''' were pieces of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] that some individuals wore around their waists, generally to hold up pants, or to carry tools, weapons, and other devices. Belts sometimes had pouches and [[Holster/Legends|holsters]], and came in many [[Color/Legends|colors]].

{{Clothes-stub}}
